info.name: SFC Paddy Procurement and CMR — Complete Workflow
info.description:
API reference collection with master requests grouped under Masters by resource. Each master groups Add, List, Update (where supported) and Delete. Master detail and restore requests are omitted; use List for records and IDs. Role-specific login requests remain separate. Configure environment variables and the appropriate tokens before sending. Send requests manually; this collection is not a sequential demo run. Every mutation requires a fresh Idempotency-Key; retry_key is only for an identical retry. Core APIs require their corresponding real core tokens and integration.

Trip tracking: folder 15 includes trip detail and numeric trip-status filtering. Configure expected_completion_at in the active environment for an optional planned completion time. Start/completion actuals are set by GPS.

These fields are read-only and appear in List. On creation mapping_status and status_updated_at are null. Editing IMEI/provider/location does not change these fields. First vehicle mapping sets MAPPED and the timestamp. Deactivating a mapping sets AVAILABLE and updates the timestamp.
